summary: OSU Computer Science & Engineering honors student on a pre-medical track with hands-on biomedical research and applied ML experience spanning medical imaging, organ-assessment pipelines, and injury biomechanics.

experience.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
bullets: Trained in BSL-2 protocols, DXA/CT imaging workflows, scalpel technique, and PMHS handling for injury biomechanics research.
Developing a MATLAB-usable simulation and visualization tool integrating the MS-Human-700 model, MuJoCo physics simulation, and Vicon motion-capture data.

experience.title: Clinical Volunteer
bullets: Accumulated ~100 hours supporting patient intake, working under and reporting to the attending physician.
Developing a patient-facing clinic website and exploring athenahealth integration.

experience.title: Summer Research Fellow
bullets: Extended a BioHack prototype into an AI-assisted pipeline for donor-kidney assessment during normothermic machine perfusion.
Built a calibrated XGBoost donor-risk classifier (>95.5% precision); built real-time organ-monitoring alerts; presented at the COE-SURE Research Symposium.

experience.title: Research Collaborator (Dr. Simeng Zhu)
bullets: Developed ML models to identify and outline brain tumors on MRI for the MICCAI BraTS Challenge using Ohio Supercomputer Center resources.

experience.title: Multimedia Analyst
bullets: Annotated image, video, and audio datasets; refined labeling guidelines and QA protocols for high-precision data.

education.field: Computer Science and Engineering (University Honors; Pre-Medical Track)

preferences.target: Summer 2027 internships; also open to night/weekend clinical roles year-round (for clinical hours)
